name: Anime highlight from a different angle
prompt_reference: Generate a highly accurate anime rendition of this scene from an angle where the face of the star player can be seen. Turn this into a dramatic anime scene where {description} is happening, highly stylized and pay attention to details.
prompt_template: Anime highlight edit of this moment: {{description}}. Emphasize drama and intensity.
ref_frame_prompt: Anime-style football highlight still frame. Show the action clearly: {description}. Vertical 9:16.
